'''Shud Haloo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for the [[smuggler]] [[Rycar Ryjerd/Legends|Rycar Ryjerd]]. One time, as Ryjerd was confronted with a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] out to capture him, Haloo and Ryjerd ambushed them with an [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]].
